description: This Java class 'LoanTransactionValidatorImpl' implements validation logic for various loan transaction operations within the Apache Fineract platform. It ensures correctness of disbursements, repayments, refunds, charge-offs, and other financial activities related to loans, by checking date constraints, account statuses, collateral sufficiency, and external dependencies. The class integrates with multiple other services and repositories to enforce business rules and data integrity during loan processing.

classes.name: LoanTransactionValidatorImpl
classes.description: Implementation of the LoanTransactionValidator interface providing comprehensive validation for loan transaction operations, including disbursements, repayments, refunds, charge-offs, and loan rescheduling, utilizing multiple internal and external dependencies to enforce business rules and data integrity.

classes.name: LoanTransactionValidatorImpl
classes.description: Implementation of the LoanTransactionValidator interface providing validation for loan transaction operations, including manual interest refunds and classification code validation.

methods.name: validateDisbursement
methods.description: Validates loan disbursement parameters including dates, amounts, collateral, and compliance with scheduled meeting dates, ensuring disbursement occurs in authorized states and conditions.

methods.name: validateUndoChargeOff
methods.description: Validates parameters for undoing a loan charge-off, primarily checking external identifiers.

methods.name: validateTransaction
methods.description: Validates general loan transaction data including date, amount, and associated payment details.

methods.name: validateChargebackTransaction
methods.description: Ensures a transaction intended as a chargeback is correctly identified and validated.

methods.name: validateNewRepaymentTransaction
methods.description: Validates new repayment transactions for correctness in date and amount.

methods.name: validateTransactionWithNoAmount
methods.description: Validates transactions purposely with zero amount, focusing on metadata.

methods.name: validateChargeOffTransaction
methods.description: Ensures charge-off transactions meet date and external identifier requirements.

methods.name: validateUpdateOfLoanOfficer
methods.description: Validates updates to loan officer assignments, including assignment dates.

methods.name: validateForBulkLoanReassignment
methods.description: Validates parameters for reassigning multiple loans between officers.

methods.name: validateMarkAsFraudLoan
methods.description: Sets validation for marking a loan as fraud based on external attributes.

methods.name: validateUpdateDisbursementDateAndAmount
methods.description: Validates updates to disbursement date and principal amount for a loan.

methods.name: validateNewRefundTransaction
methods.description: Validates refund transactions similar to repayment validation.

methods.name: validateLoanForeclosure
methods.description: Checks parameters for loan foreclosure activities.

methods.name: validateLoanClientIsActive
methods.description: Ensures the associated client is active before proceeding with transactions.

methods.name: validateLoanGroupIsActive
methods.description: Ensures the associated group is active before proceeding with transactions.

methods.name: validateLoanHasNoLaterChargeRefundTransactionToReverseOrCreateATransaction
methods.description: Checks for existing charge refunds preceding certain operations.

methods.name: validateLoanDisbursementIsBeforeTransactionDate
methods.description: Checks that disbursement date precedes transaction date.

methods.name: validateTransactionShouldNotBeInTheFuture
methods.description: Prevents future-dated transactions.

methods.name: validateLoanHasCurrency
methods.description: Verifies that the loan has a valid currency.

methods.name: validateClientOfficeJoiningDateIsBeforeTransactionDate
methods.description: Ensures client's transfer date is before transaction date.

methods.name: validateActivityNotBeforeLastTransactionDate
methods.description: Ensures new activities are not dated before the last transaction.

methods.name: validateRepaymentDateIsOnNonWorkingDay
methods.description: Checks if repayment date falls on a non-working day when not allowed.

methods.name: validateRepaymentDateIsOnHoliday
methods.description: Checks if repayment date falls on a holiday when not allowed.

methods.name: validateTransactionAmountNotExceedThresholdForMultiDisburseLoan
methods.description: Ensures transaction amounts do not exceed business thresholds for multi-disburse loans.

methods.name: validateLoanTransactionInterestPaymentWaiver
methods.description: Validates interest waiver transactions including state and date constraints.

methods.name: validateLoanTransactionInterestPaymentWaiverAfterRecalculation
methods.description: Re-validates interest waiver transactions after recalculations.

methods.name: validateRefund
methods.description: Validates refund transactions.

methods.name: validateReversalExternalId
methods.description: Validates external IDs for reversals.

methods.name: validateManualInterestRefundTransaction
methods.description: Validates manually initiated interest refunds.

methods.name: validateLoanRescheduleDate
methods.description: Validates rescheduling dates against disbursement dates and future dates.

methods.name: validateNote
methods.description: Checks length constraints on notes.

methods.name: validateExternalId
methods.description: Validates length constraints on external IDs.

methods.name: validateReversalExternalId
methods.description: Validates reversal external IDs.

methods.name: validateActivityNotBeforeClientOrGroupTransferDate
methods.description: Ensures activities are not dated before client's transfer date.

methods.name: validateTransactionNotBeforeLastTransactionDate
methods.description: Checks that transactions are not before last transaction date for consistency.

methods.name: validateIfTransactionIsChargeback
methods.description: Confirms that a transaction is of chargeback type.

methods.name: validateManualInterestRefundTransaction
methods.description: Validates manually initiated interest refund transactions for correctness in parameters such as transaction amount, note length, external ID, and payment details, throwing exceptions if validation fails.

methods.name: validateClassificationCodeValue
methods.description: Validates that a given classification code ID exists for a specified code name, ensuring data integrity for transaction classification.
